summary: Prudential plc filed Form 6-K disclosing a director/PDMR share transaction under its Restricted Stock Plan. On 30 June 2026, PDMR Naveen Tahilyani acquired 41,153 ordinary shares for nil consideration after release of a 2025 award. No price, premium, or deal terms are involved. The filing is a routine compensation disclosure, not a special situation. This maps to a standard insider ownership notice under US rules.
